hero.sub: Professional hairstyling. Attention to detail. Personalized style.

about.label: About us
about.p1: At NORD, every haircut starts with attention to detail and precise technique. We work with professional tools and products, for a result tailored to you.
about.p2: Our hairstylists are certified professionals, with experience in hairstyling competitions and continuous training.
about.p3: A modern, comfortable space where your style gets the time and precision it deserves.

services.label: Services
services.heading: Every detail counts.
services.sub: From the first line to the final finish, every service is built around precision, technique and personal style.

items.title: PRECISION CUT
items.name: Haircut
items.desc: A cut built around your shape, proportions and style. Every detail is adjusted with precision for a clean, easy-to-wear result.

items.title: CLIPPER CUT
items.name: Clipper cut
items.desc: Precise lines, clean transitions and a flawless finish. For a sharp, modern and well-defined look.

items.title: STYLE & FINISH
items.name: Styling
items.desc: From prepping the hair to the final shape. Professional products and techniques adapted to your hair type and desired look.

items.title: PRECISION DETAIL
items.name: Detailing
items.desc: The finishing touches that make the difference. Outlines, details and precise adjustments for a perfectly defined result.
